issues.description: notes.md states '状态: published' (line 7) and '最终状态: published' (end of file) which is inconsistent with manifest.yaml 'status: built'. The P1 fix correctly changed manifest.yaml from published to built (verified but not CI-uploaded), but notes.md was not updated to reflect this change. The term 'published' in the Conan context means 'CI upload succeeded', which is not the case for this pre-PR state. While manifest.yaml is the authoritative status file and is correct, the notes.md inconsistency could mislead reviewers.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update notes.md to replace '状态: published' with '状态: built' and '最终状态: published' with '最终状态: built (验证通过，未上传CI)' to maintain consistency with manifest.yaml.

issues.description: Output format uses [test]/✅/❌ markers instead of the standard [step]/[ok]/[fail]/[warn] markers specified in code style rule 9. The rule requires step markers as [step], success as [ok], failure as [fail], with 8-space indentation before [ok]/[fail].
issues.fix_suggestion: Replace [test] with [step], ✅ with [ok] (with 8-space indentation), and ❌ with [fail] (with 8-space indentation) to conform to the output format standard.

issues.description: test_package/conanfile.py is missing the shebang line (#!/usr/bin/env python3) specified in code style rule 1 for conanfile.py files. The main conanfile.py correctly has the shebang, but the test_package conanfile.py does not.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add '#!/usr/bin/env python3' as the first line of test_package/conanfile.py for consistency with code style rule 1.

issues.description: Hardcoded bash path /data/service/hnp/bin/bash used in test.sh shebang and as default CONFIG_SHELL in test_package/conanfile.py. This path is environment-specific and may not exist on all CI workers. While CONFIG_SHELL env var allows overriding, the default fallback path is brittle.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider using '#!/usr/bin/env bash' for test.sh shebang. Keep the CONFIG_SHELL fallback mechanism in conanfile.py but document the expected environment, or use a more portable default path.

issues.description: notes.md contains duplicate timestamp sections (June 5 and August 5 entries) with inconsistent build dates. The '编译日期: 2026-06-05' conflicts with manifest.yaml build_date '2026-08-05'. There are two '编译结束' entries (2026-06-05 10:44 and 2026-08-05 07:39) and two '最终状态' entries, suggesting stale content from a previous build attempt was not cleaned up.
issues.fix_suggestion: Clean up notes.md to remove stale June 5 entries, align build date with manifest.yaml's build_date '2026-08-05', and consolidate the duplicate timestamp/status sections.
